block.omnivoice.workflow: Generate complete speech files locally. Choose automatic voice, voice design, or an authorized reference with its transcript. Prepare the model, codec and Python environment first.
block.omnivoice.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.omnivoice.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.omnivoice.invalid_config: Check the OmniVoice settings and limits.
block.omnivoice.model.title: OmniVoice
block.omnivoice.model.description: Local OmniVoice speech synthesis with automatic, designed or reference voices.
block.omnivoice.help_asset_directory: Prepare the pinned 3.27 GB snapshot first. Runtime verifies local files and never downloads.
block.omnivoice.help_environment_python: Dedicated Python 3.12 with pinned OmniVoice dependencies. Empty uses the app interpreter only if compatible.
block.omnivoice.help_voice_mode: Automatic voice, supported voice attributes, or an authorized reference plus its transcript.
block.omnivoice.help_language: Auto, or search an official language code/name. Language names shown in the list are upstream data; quality is model-dependent.
block.omnivoice.help_voice_instruction: Comma-separated: female, young adult, low pitch, british accent, whisper. One value per category. See README for all attributes.
block.omnivoice.help_reference_audio: Authorized, completed local audio, 0.5–20 seconds, at most 32 MiB. 3–10 seconds recommended. Source is preserved.
block.omnivoice.help_reference_text: Required exact words of the reference recording. No automatic Whisper model or hidden STT download.
block.omnivoice.help_device: Explicit CPU or CUDA device 0. No silent device fallback; weights reload per request.
block.omnivoice.help_precision: CPU requires float32. CUDA also accepts float16/bfloat16. The codec stays float32.
block.omnivoice.help_format: Complete mono WAV at 24 kHz or Ogg/Opus at 48 kHz. This is not a live audio-stream port.
block.omnivoice.help_output_directory: Empty uses this node’s persistent audio directory. Unique names, no overwrites or automatic deletion.
block.omnivoice.help_target_duration_sec: Native duration in 40 ms frames. Overrides speed. Padding counts toward the maximum; post-processing can shorten it.
block.omnivoice.help_speed: Native factor: above 1 speaks faster. Ignored when target duration is set.
block.omnivoice.help_num_step: 32 by default; 16 is faster. Every scheduled step and every audio code must complete.
block.omnivoice.help_position_temperatur: Native mask-position sampling; 0 is greedy, default 5.
block.omnivoice.help_layer_penalty_facto: Encourage earlier codebook layers to unmask first; default 5.
block.omnivoice.help_pad_duration: Silence added at each end; included in the maximum output duration.
block.omnivoice.help_audio_chunk_duratio: Native punctuation-based chunking. Must not exceed the chunk threshold.
block.omnivoice.help_audio_chunk_thresho: Above this estimated duration, use all native chunks in order.
block.omnivoice.help_max_audio_sec: Reject overlong estimates/chunks/results. Never silently crop speech.
block.omnivoice.help_max_segments: Refuse extra segments before generating them. All planned segments must be present.
block.omnivoice.help_max_context_tokens: Bounds native attention allocation before each diffusion batch.
block.omnivoice.help_max_text_chars: Reject oversized input. Inline pronunciation and non-verbal tags stay native.
block.omnivoice.help_timeout_sec: Verification, loading, inference, encoding and publication share this deadline.
block.omnivoice.help_memory_limit_mib: 0 disables the ceiling, otherwise at least 4096 MiB. CUDA reserves large virtual ranges; this is not reserved RAM.
block.omnivoice.help_min_available_ram_m: Default 8 GiB; weight-based CPU/VRAM checks also apply. No memory reservation.
block.omnivoice.help_max_pending: Active Runtime only. 0 rejects text while busy. Interrupt clears earlier requests.
block.omnivoice.help_denoise: Native denoise token, not a filter on your reference file.
block.omnivoice.help_preprocess_prompt: Native removal of long silence and punctuation completion, on the private reference copy only.
block.omnivoice.help_postprocess_output: Native removal of long silences; may shorten the target duration. Fades and padding remain separate.
